worldwidePolicy: Localise language, currency displays, date formats, accessibility and applicable consent/opt-out requirements before release; no assumption of worldwide provider availability.

sequences.name: Welcome
sequences.audience: People who explicitly opted in to product emails
sequences.subject: Welcome to Easy Agent Video Pro 3.1
sequences.body: Thanks for your interest. Easy Agent Video Pro 3.1 is in development. Explore the preview and share the video workflow you need. Generation and paid plans are not yet available. Manage your email preferences or unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}.

sequences.name: First project guidance
sequences.audience: Opted-in users who have not completed a first project
sequences.subject: Plan your first video project
sequences.body: Start with your audience, a short script and a shot list. Add references you have permission to use, then review the planned shots. Live generation availability will be announced when validated. Preferences and unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}.

sequences.name: Project reminder
sequences.audience: Opted-in users eligible under a reviewed retention policy
sequences.subject: Ready to revisit your video idea?
sequences.body: Your next video can begin with a simple shot plan. Return to review your project when convenient. This email does not promise generation quality or earnings. Preferences and unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}.

sequences.name: Construction-sector introduction
sequences.subject: Plan clear construction project videos
sequences.body: Prepare project explainers, site progress summaries and training storyboards. Review technical and safety information with a qualified person, obtain permission for site footage, and avoid presenting generated scenes as actual project evidence. Reply with the workflow you want to explore. Preferences and unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}.

sequences.name: Localised launch notice
sequences.audience: Opted-in contacts in individually reviewed launch regions
sequences.subject: Video workflows in {{locale_name}}
sequences.body: We are preparing localised workflows for {{locale_name}}. Availability, provider access and billing will be confirmed for your region before launch. No unsupported quality comparisons are made. Preferences and unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}.
